What Deep Autumn looks like

Your colouring is rich and deep with a warm cast: hair in dark brown to near black, eyes in deep brown, dark hazel or olive, and skin with golden, olive or bronze warmth. Dark, spiced colours such as oxblood, burnt orange, forest and deep teal give you instant presence, while pastels and icy shades look faded against you.

Colours Deep Autumn should avoid

Pastel Pink. Too light and cool; your depth makes it look washed out.

Baby Blue. Icy pastel that makes warm, deep skin look grey.

Best metals

Best: Antique yellow gold. Good: Bronze and copper. Skip: Bright silver.

Questions

What colours look best on Deep Autumn?

Deep Autumn suits colours that are warm-neutral, deep and medium, such as burnt coral, chili, mahogany, burnt orange, amber.

What colours should Deep Autumn avoid?

Pastel Pink: Too light and cool; your depth makes it look washed out. Baby Blue: Icy pastel that makes warm, deep skin look grey.

Gold or silver for Deep Autumn?

Best: Antique yellow gold. Also good: bronze and copper. Usually skip: bright silver.

How do I know if I'm Deep Autumn?
